# nico_allocation (Resource)

Allocations are the mechanism by which Provider can delegate Network and Compute resources to Tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_allocation" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-uuid"
  name                           = "name-value"
  tenant_id                      = "tenant-id-value"
  constraint_value               = 0
  description                    = "description-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `constraint_value` (Number) Value of the Allocation Constraint. For InstanceType, this value represents number of Machines allocated for Tenant. For IPBlock, this value represents the prefix Length of the IP Block.
- `name` (String) Concise and descriptive name for the Allocation
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant that should receive the Allocation

### Optional

- `allocation_constraint_id` (String) Path parameter: allocation_constraint_id.
- `allocation_constraints` (Attributes List) List of Allocation Constraint objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_constraints))
- `allocation_id` (String) Path parameter: allocation_id.
- `description` (String) Detailed description for the Allocation
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site where resources should be allocated

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the Allocation was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that created the Allocation
- `status` (String) Status of the Allocation
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Allocation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Allocation was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_constraints`

Read-Only:

- `constraint_type` (String) Type of the Allocation Constraint. Please note that OnDemand and Preemptible are not supported by current implementation.
- `constraint_value` (Number) Value of the Allocation Constraint. For InstanceType, this value represents number of Machines allocated for Tenant. For IPBlock, this value represents the prefix Length of the IP Block.
- `resource_type` (String) Type of the Resource that the Allocation Constraint applies to
- `resource_type_id` (String) ID of the Resource Type that the Allocation Constraint applies to. For InstanceType, this is the ID of the Instance Type. For IPBlock, this is the ID of the IP Block.


<a id="nestedatt--status_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_history`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Date/time when the associated entity assumed the status
- `message` (String) Description of the state and cause/remedy in case of error
- `status` (String) State of the associated entity at a particular time
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the associated entity was last observed with this status
